privateVars.name: jobQueue
privateVars.description: RxJS Subject used as the job queue for anime sync requests

privateVars.name: processing
privateVars.description: Set of anilistIds currently being processed to prevent duplicate jobs

privateVars.name: animeRepository
privateVars.description: Repository used to upsert fetched anime data

functions.name: onModuleInit
functions.description: Initializes the queue processor when the module starts

functions.name: addJob
functions.description: Adds an anilistId to the processing queue if it is not already being processed

functions.name: processQueue
functions.description: Subscribes to the job queue with mergeMap (concurrency 1), processing one sync job at a time with error handling and deduplication

functions.name: syncAnimeFromAniList
functions.description: Fetches anime data from AniList and upserts it into the repository

functions.name: fetchFromAniList
functions.description: Fetches detailed anime data from AniList GraphQL with retry logic (5 retries, exponential backoff) for rate limiting and network errors. Maps the response to the repository upsert shape

exceptions.name: rrInternalServerErrorException
exceptions.message: Failed to fetch from AniList: No response received
